candidates.reason: Headline is strong, but the badges are swapped (LIMITED RUN before NEW) and NEW is blown up into a CTA-sized orange pill that competes with 'Shop the Launch'. 'Swipe up to shop' is squeezed into a 3-line sliver against the right edge. The right column is cramped while the can is shrunk and loses its sun icon, and the headline nearly touches the can circle.

Sensible left-to-right split with a clear headline-to-CTA order. However, the badge row sticks out left of the centred text column and nearly touches the can's circle. The headline crowds the top edge, 'Swipe up to shop' and the SOLSTICE label are tiny, and a large empty area sits at far left.

Close to candidate 3 and still a reasonable banner. The NEW badge sits almost on the circle's edge and breaks the text column's axis. The headline is tight to the top edge and 'Swipe up to shop' is tiny, but the text and can are slightly larger than in candidate 2.

The whole portrait design is shrunk into a tiny centred stack, so the body copy, badges, CTA label and swipe line are unreadable. About 80% of the banner is dead space, and the layout was not rearranged for the new format.
